title: Observation is state-clean and root gates isolate managed worktrees
statement: Every supported diagnostic, score, validation, verification, doctor, and policy-check observation MUST be non-recording and MUST leave tracked repository state byte-identical; canonical SensorReading or evidence persistence MUST be a distinct registered role-declared write-consented mutation over the exact emitted artifact; a root gate MUST exclude every discovered nested managed worktree and MUST validate any candidate worktree only when invoked from that worktree's own root.
rationale: A read action that appends state contradicts the fail-closed action registry, while a root gate that traverses another checkout makes its result depend on unrelated work rather than the evaluated tree.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
